subject: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Carmen Ruiz <carmen@brightways.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications

Hi team — attaching the Q2 comp band refresh and a brief geo-anchor analysis from Mira at CompBench. High-level asks:

- Approve the proposed west-coast anchor uplift (+6%) for Senior IC/Lead levels to keep offers competitive in SF/SEA.
- Confirm whether we want a hard cap on total OTE at L5 in USD for remote hires outside US (we proposed $255k).
- Agree a communication plan for People Ops and recruiting so offers are consistent for active candidates next week.

Attachments: 2026-q2-comp-bands-v2.xlsx (band table), geo-anchor-analysis-apr2026.pdf (external benchmark)

Notes: Mira's benchmark uses 2025 actuals adjusted to 2026 CPI; Carmen from BrightWays flagged that competitive offers there have moved faster than expected in the last 6 months.

Thanks — I need approvals for the uplift and the L5 cap by end of day Monday so recruiting can proceed.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Talent & People Ops (hiring partner for Engineering)
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications

Marissa — thanks, read the deck. Quick thoughts:

- I support the +6% west-coast uplift for individual contributors at L4/L5; near-term throughput risk if we don't.
- For L5 OTE cap at $255k: prefer a soft cap with executive approval path for exceptional hires (market scarcity / strategic hires). Hard caps slow down closing and we'll just ask for exceptions.
- Curious if Mira's data breaks out equity median vs. 75th percentile; don't want to compress equity take for later-stage hires.

If we go soft-cap + approval path, I can take the exception workflow to Finance to pre-approve thresholds so we don't block offers.

Vivek
VP, Product & GTM
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2026 14:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications

Appreciate the fast turnaround. My comments:

- Approve west-coast uplift for L4/L5 as a temporary Q2 measure; add review checkpoint at end of Q3.
- Make the L5 cap a soft guideline — exceptions routed to me + Finance (Vivek's suggestion).
- Please add a short FAQ for recruiting to reference when candidates push on total comp (explain uplift rationale + how equity is evaluated).

One operational note: ensure the Offer Letter template calls out the geo-anchor as an adjustment in the compensation table so there's no confusion for the candidate.

Evelyn
Head of People Operations (interim)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Carmen Ruiz <carmen@brightways.com>, Mira Patel <mira@compbench.co>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications

Looping in a quick recruiting checklist so we can operationalize:

1) Candidate-facing band callout: include base, target OTE, equity range, and geo-anchor multiplier in the Offer Summary.
2) Internal approval: for offers within 5% of benchmark up to soft cap — recruiting + hiring manager sign-off; >5% or above soft cap — route to Evelyn + Finance.
3) Timing: start using the uplift for active offers submitted after 2026-04-13.

Questions for leadership:
- Do we want a separate bucket for "strategic hires" (e.g., Critical IC/Foundational roles) that auto-qualify for exception review without prior approval? That would speed closures in urgent cases.

Fwd included earlier attachments.

—Aditya
Senior Technical Recruiter
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Carmen Ruiz <carmen@brightways.com>, Mira Patel <mira@compbench.co>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: Geo anchor adjustments and comp band clarifications

Thanks all — decision:

- Approve west-coast anchor uplift (+6%) for L4/L5 for Q2 starting 2026-04-13; review at end of Q3.
- L5 USD OTE guideline set to $255k as a soft cap. Exceptions: route to Evelyn + Finance (Vivek) with a short note on strategic rationale.
- Create a short FAQ + updated Offer Letter template (Aditya to coordinate with Legal) before we publish to hiring teams.
- Strategic hires: yes, we'll create a "strategic" fast-track bucket; hiring manager must justify strategic business impact in the exception request.

I've uploaded the final, annotated band table: 2026-q2-comp-bands-v2.xlsx and the benchmark PDF from Mira. Carmen/Mira — thank you for the rapid benchmark.

Marissa
Head of Talent & People Ops
Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: 2026-q2-comp-bands-v2.xlsx (band table v2, annotated), geo-anchor-analysis-apr2026.pdf (external benchmarks)
